methods.text: Highway Safety Improvement Program Process (Arkansas Department of Transportation (ARDOT), Version 2.0, 12/2022), App. E, p. E-2 (PDF p. 59), 'Adjusted Crash Cost Estimates by Crash Severity'; dollar year from p. E-3 '(Adjusted for 2020 dollars)'

not available for Arkansas: ARDOT computes statewide average crash rates by roadway type (Traffic Safety section duties) but the HSIP Process document doesn't print them, and CrashIQ has no Arkansas traffic counts

Highway Safety Manual (AASHTO, 1st, 2010), Ch. 4, Sec. 4.2.3. Arkansas's own method, Critical KA Crash Rate, ranked by Critical Index (KA rate / critical KA rate); intersections ~160 ft influence on each leg (ARDOT HSIP Process 2022, §2.2.1, pp. 10-11), isn't built: this report uses the HSM critical rate against the corridor's own sites (national method)
not available for Arkansas: ARDOT ranks on five-year crash totals (App. E, p. E-2; App. F, p. F-2) but sets no minimum study period for a corridor study
